column3: The altar is definite, “the altar,” rather than “an altar.”
Names four bronze rings at the four extremities, rather than expressing the number as one ring at each corner.
Ends with the plural active “they will make it,” rather than an impersonal passive.
Retains the shoulder term used for the side of the entrance.
“The second side” preserves the ordinal rather than “the other side.”
Describes a screen of twenty cubits for the gate, rather than making the gate itself the grammatical subject of the measurement.
Repeats “fifty” in the width specification; BSB states it once.
The lamp is singular rather than the plural “lamps.”
The object being tended is singular “it,” rather than the plural “the lamps.”
